evidence.quote: 2% for copper
the absolute volumes in 2030 still reach 512 kilotonnes (kt) of copper

text: IEA (via The Oregon Group): data-centre build-out adds about 2% to copper demand by 2030 versus 2024, about 512 kt.

evidence.quote: data centers consumed about 4.4% of total U.S. electricity in 2023 and are expected to consume approximately 6.7 to 12% of total U.S. electricity by 2028

text: LBNL/DOE: US data centres used 4.4% of US electricity in 2023 and could use 6.7% to 12% by 2028.

evidence.quote: Incumbents can’t simply tear down their UIs and business models to pivot
categories that have historically monetized gatekept institutional knowledge will be most susceptible
Law is obviously at risk (Harvey and Legora are exploding)

text: Mignano argues agents will reorganize markets as the internet and mobile did, because incumbents can't tear down their UIs and business models, and categories that monetize gatekept institutional knowledge (law, medicine, personal finance) are most exposed.

evidence.quote: Vistra closed nearly 30% lower, erasing its gains for 2025. Constellation Energy, Talen Energy and GE Vernova tumbled more than 20%

text: On the DeepSeek day (2025-01-27) Vistra closed nearly 30% lower and Constellation, Talen and GE Vernova fell more than 20% as investors questioned AI power demand.

evidence.quote: Data centres account for around one-tenth of global electricity demand growth to 2030, less than the share from industrial motors, air conditioning in homes and offices, or electric vehicles.

text: IEA: globally, data centres are only about one-tenth of electricity demand growth to 2030, less than industrial motors, air conditioning or EVs.

evidence.quote: copper demand from the sector will average around 400,000 tonnes annually over the next decade, peaking at 572,000 tonnes in 2028
potentially pushing the supply shortfall to 6 million tonnes by 2035

text: BNEF: data centres need about 400,000 t of copper a year over the next decade, peaking at 572,000 t in 2028, adding to a supply shortfall it sees reaching 6 Mt by 2035.

evidence.quote: In the United States, data centres account for nearly half of electricity demand growth between now and 2030.
Data centre electricity consumption is set to more than double to around 945 TWh by 2030.

text: IEA: in the US, data centres are nearly half of electricity demand growth to 2030; global data-centre use more than doubles to about 945 TWh, with AI the main driver.

evidence.quote: the global refined copper market would remain in surplus through 2027, with it widening from about 104 000 metric tons in 2026 to 368 000 metric tons in 2027

text: ICSG (Oct 2026) forecasts a refined copper surplus of about 104 kt in 2026 widening to 368 kt in 2027, with mine output +1.3% and +3.1%.

evidence.quote: approximately 80% are traditional customers and 20% are for
data center orders to over $5 billion in the first half of 2026, more than double full-year

text: GE Vernova: about 20% of its gas-turbine gigawatts under contract are for data centers (80% traditional customers); Electrification data-center orders exceeded $5B in 1H26, more than double 2025.

evidence.quote: you can basically get fee-free, liquid, and leverageable frontier-ish exposure with copper/power/etc today and basically no one cares
if you really want just a simple way to bet on AI
just bet on energy

text: Will Manidis says copper, power and similar commodities give fee-free, liquid, leverageable exposure to AI that almost no one is using; the quoted clip has Fred Wilson saying the simple way to bet on AI is to bet on energy.

evidence.quote: Constellation, for example, has signed a power agreement with Microsoft to restart the Three Mile Island nuclear plant
Talen is powering an Amazon data center with electricity from the nearby Susquehanna nuclear plant.

text: Constellation has a Microsoft deal to restart Three Mile Island and Talen powers an Amazon data center from Susquehanna: listed IPPs hold direct AI offtake contracts.

evidence.quote: electricity demand from data centres is 20% lower in 2035 than in the Base Case
spans from 700 to 1 700 TWh

text: IEA High Efficiency Case: data-centre electricity demand 20% lower in 2035 than Base; 2035 range across cases 700 to 1,700 TWh.
